purpose: Personal historical economic feasibility screen only: can a CNY 10000 fully funded spot-long / USDT-perpetual-short carry justify quote-only paper validation after all declared costs and capital constraints?
fx_note: Fixed reporting conversion, not a market quote or a claim of USDT/USD/CNY parity; separate no-conversion-cost and 50bp-per-side conversion-haircut results; no assumed FX profit.
position_rule: Buy spot and short identical BTC quantity; choose largest fixed step satisfying spot budget including entry fee and initial perpetual notional no greater than futures collateral budget. No borrowed cash/coin, no reinvestment or rebalancing, no fee-rate timing or selecting only positive future funding.
reserve_rule: Cash reserve is part of initial capital, not income or expense. No automatic transfers from spot gains or reserve into futures wallet in primary path. Also report a diagnostic that hypothetically makes the entire initial reserve available; not an executable top-up policy.

holding_scenarios.continuous_year: Independent CNY10000 account at Jan1 for each complete UTC year. Enter after the first open, hold fixed quantity to Dec31 final close; monthly P&L is change in year-account net liquidation equity including all exit liabilities. No reset between months, no extra capital after losses.
holding_scenarios.independent_months: Each calendar month starts a separate hypothetical CNY10000 account and includes all four fills and FX haircuts. Diagnostic of short holding-period economics; do not sum as a realizable income stream or silently refill a losing account.

execution: Entry uses synchronous first-hour spot/perpetual trade opens plus adverse slippage; exit and hypothetical liquidation use corresponding completed-hour closes plus adverse slippage. Historical OHLCV lacks bid/ask, depth, simultaneous fill or delay guarantees.
funding: Prefer exact settled markPrice if lawfully accessible. Local official API HEAD returned HTTP451 before downloading outcomes, so use official archive calc_time/rate plus same-hour mark OPEN as labelled estimate. Bound every payment using that hour mark LOW/HIGH with signed-rate-aware ordering, and propagate cumulative lower/upper funding through net equity and margin. Never call these exact settlement payments. Actual timestamps and interval changes are retained; entry-boundary first minute funding excluded.
cost_note: Fees are declared assumptions without VIP/BNB/maker discounts, not recovered account-specific historical rates. Conversion haircut is a sensitivity assumption, not a quoted channel fee. Margin and reserve lower deployed notional but are not subtracted as losses.

risk.margin_note: Separate short-wallet equity checked at each mark close and conservatively against each hourly mark high; compare with assumed 2% of short marked notional. This is a deliberately declared diagnostic proxy, not historical exchange maintenance brackets or liquidation price. Any breach makes subsequent buy-and-hold funding receipts non-executable under the primary assumptions; do not present theoretical full-year P&L as attainable.
risk.liquidation_equity: spot cash + spot hypothetical sale net + separate futures collateral + funding + short unrealized P&L - short hypothetical buyback fee + untouched reserve; then conversion exit haircut
risk.drawdown: hourly-close net liquidation equity including initial capital; conservative intrahour bounds reported separately, not as observed synchronized drawdown
stress_cases: funding fixed at -0.01% per 8h for 30 days (synthetic)
perpetual premium widens 5 percentage points while spot is unchanged (synthetic)
spot and perpetual both double from entry; test separate short-wallet solvency (synthetic)
venue failure: all on-venue capital potentially lost; not estimated from benign history

decision: Only consider quote-only paper monitoring if both complete years have positive continuous-year FUNDING-LOWER-BOUND net profit under base AND stress and neither has a 2% separate-wallet diagnostic breach. Otherwise do not build/enable dual-leg execution; distinguish profitability, capital/margin incompatibility and data limits. If all payment bounds positive but exact data absent, only quote-only simulation can be proposed, never execution validation.
data_policy: Full UTC 2024 and 2025 spot/perpetual trade and mark-price 1h archives plus fundingRate archives, published SHA256, raw CSV/ZIP, timestamps and interval columns preserved. Official funding API unavailable HTTP451, no bypass. Hourly mark-based funding estimates and low/high bounds replace unavailable exact settlement marks; bounds are conditional on accuracy of archived mark extrema, not venue guarantees. No invented bars or funding rows.
scope_boundary: No accounts, keys, real trades, actual leverage/risk-limit settings, new recurring task, GUI rebuild or changes to previous paper account. Asset/stablecoin/FX/venue and account eligibility remain separate from this personal historical screen.
quantity_step_note: 0.001 BTC is a declared research lot-size assumption, not a verified current or historical exchange filter; public exchangeInfo returned HTTP451.
